name: Telegram Videos
description: Plays the videos in your Telegram groups and channels; QR sign-in. Needs your own Telegram API ID and hash (my.telegram.org).
pre_build: cd build && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && mkdir -p out && npx esbuild src/worker.js --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --loader:.wasm=binary --minify --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning --outfile=out/worker.bundle.txt && npx esbuild src/entry.js --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --loader:.wasm=binary --loader:.txt=text --minify --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning --outfile=../app/js/tg.bundle.js && cd .. && touch app/js/sites.local.js
